stories.title: Create BEV C05 Supervisory Performance Assessment with Role-Based Rubrics
stories.description: Develop PA.md for BEV C05 supervisory competencies with performance-based evaluation criteria, supervisor role rubrics, and incident management assessments aligned with NOSS G452-010-3:2023 assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md created at bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05-supervisory/PA.md with 4+ competency rubrics (briefing delivery, trainee supervision, SHE monitoring, incident response)
Each rubric includes 5-point competency scale (1=Novice to 5=Expert) with behavioral descriptors in English and Malay
PA.md cross-references all C05 Work Activities (KK files) and NOSS assessment criteria
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05-supervisory/PA.md with standard PA structure (intro, competency rubrics, marking guide, supervisor checklist)
Test command: validate PA structure against JPK WIM format standard and verify bilingual term pairs

stories.title: Build Multi-Format Knowledge Assessment for IT C01-C02 with Integrated Answer Schemes
stories.description: Create comprehensive KA.md files for IT Fundamentals and System Configuration with diverse question formats (MCQ, true/false, scenario-based), complete answer schemes, and marking rubrics aligned with IT-020:2013 NOSS coverage and competency levels.
acceptanceCriteria: Two KA files created: it-computer-system/C01-fundamentals/KA.md (30+ questions) and it-computer-system/C02-configuration/KA.md (25+ questions), each with minimum 3 different question formats
Each question includes: question text (EN/BM pair), correct answer, marking rubric (0-100 scale), and reference to source KP section
Total question set covers all Related Knowledge (RK) topics from IT-020 NOSS CoCU; coverage mapping document provided
technicalNotes: Files to create: it-computer-system/C01-fundamentals/KA.md, it-computer-system/C02-configuration/KA.md with standard KA structure (intro, questions with answer schemes, rubrics, answer key)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_it_assessments.py -v (validates question count, bilingual pairs present, CoCU mapping, rubric format)

stories.title: Develop WIM Multilingual Consistency Validator - Terminology and NOSS Coverage Audit Tool
stories.description: Build Python validator tool that audits all WIM materials across BEV, Aesthetic, and IT pathways for: (1) bilingual term consistency (same EN term = same BM translation within subject), (2) complete NOSS CoCU coverage (all RK→KP, all WA→KK), and (3) WIM format compliance per JPK standard.
acceptanceCriteria: Python validator script created at _agents/validators/wim_coverage_validator.py; validates bilingual term consistency within each subject and reports terminology conflicts (same EN term with multiple BM translations)

Validator verifies complete NOSS coverage: extracts all Related Knowledge (RK) and Work Activities (WA) from NOSS source files, confirms corresponding KP and KK files exist, generates coverage gap report
Validator runs on all three subjects (BEV, Aesthetic, IT) and outputs combined compliance report to _agents/validators/reports/coverage-audit-{date}.md with summary statistics and actionable fix list
technicalNotes: File to create: _agents/validators/wim_coverage_validator.py (functions: extract_bilingual_terms, validate_noss_coverage, generate_gap_report, export_report_markdown)
File to create: tests/test_wim_validator.py with 12+ test cases covering bilingual consistency, coverage validation, and report generation
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_wim_validator.py -v
